final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avgc FROM g) SELECT g.src, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share, g.cnt * 1.0 / a.avgc AS rel_to_avg FROM g, t, a ORDER BY g.cnt DESC
